Class CSVParser

java.lang.Object
gate.lang.csv.CSVParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
Parser, AutoCloseable, Iterable<Row>
public class CSVParser extends Object implements Parser
Extracts Lists of strings from a CSV formatted Reader.
